text:
elaine: Heads-up: planning coordinated unpin of SDK v3.0 + runtime v4.1 for a tiny canary (2% traffic) next Tue 01:10 UTC. This pairing fixes a batch-serialization bug. Need a tight rollback ladder and a short manual abort path.

peter: Can we avoid changing both at once? last time the interaction made debugging painful.

elaine: I hear you. We evaluated split rollout but the bug only reproduces when sdk v3.0 talks to runtime v4.1. Doing it together reduces total waves; we keep cohort small and strict gates.

jon: Proposal: dry-run (no traffic) at 00:10, then canary 01:10 -> 2% -> 20m watch -> widen if green. Auto-rollback ON but require infra+quality gates BOTH fail to auto-rollback; single severe infra spike should trigger immediate abort.

perf: Metric thresholds I suggest: p95 gen latency delta vs baseline < +70ms, 5xx rate < 0.35%, client sdk errors < 0.25%. For a hard abort: p95 > +150ms sustained 3m OR 5xx > 1% for any 1m window.

qa-bot: QA-Bot: will queue smoke set: smoke-sdk-runtime-pair-v1. It posts pass/fail to this thread.

deploybot: Deploybot: planned commands:
```
/deploybot unpin --component=sdk --version=v3.0 --component=runtime --version=v4.1 --cohort=canary --window=20m --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/sdk3-runtime4-quick.yaml
/deploybot dry-run --components=sdk@v3.0,runtime@v4.1 --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/sdk3-runtime4-quick.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases
```

peter: PromQL for gate file (copy-paste ready):
```promql
# p95 generation latency for runtime v4.1
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime="v4.1"}[5m])) by (le))

# 5xx rate for runtime v4.1
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v4.1", code=~"5.."}[1m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime="v4.1"}[1m]))
```

jon: Rollback ladder: 1) immediate abort: flip route weight to 0 for runtime v4.1 (`/route set-weight runtime=v4.1 weight=0 --cohort=canary`) 2) flip feature-flag if present 3) full rollback via `/deploybot rollback runtime=v4.1 sdk=v3.0`. First action reduces traffic instantly without touching SDK.

perf: Also add trace-sample threshold: token-drop spikes > 8 in 1m -> auto-abort. Good to capture traces quickly.

elaine: On-call: @jon primary, @peter secondary. If auto-rollback triggers, deploybot should create PT and post gate-report id. Manual rollback allowed with `/deploybot rollback sdk=v3.0 runtime=v4.1 --reason="manual triage"`.

qa-bot: Smoke eval dry-run queued for 00:10 UTC. Will post result and attached artifact.

peter: Release note blurb: "Canary: SDK v3.0 + Runtime v4.1 to 2% traffic. Auto-abort/rollback guards for latency, errors, and token anomalies. Tenant exclusions applied for major partners."

elaine: Ops checklist before 00:10 dry-run:
- gate file reviewed (peter)
- smoke eval queued (qa-bot)
- on-call confirmed (jon/peter)
- release note draft (elaine)
If dry-run green, we proceed to canary at 01:10.

deploybot: Dry-run scheduled at 3601237200 (00:10 UTC). Canary tentatively scheduled at 3601242600 (01:10 UTC) pending manual go. I will post the dry-run gate-report to this thread when complete.

jon: I'll be online for the canary window and will monitor the dashboard. If I see p95 creeping towards perf's hard abort limits I'll execute the route-throttle first.

elaine: Thanks team. If anything looks odd during dry-run call it out here and hold the canary. :thumbsup:
